## Action.commands property

Retrieves the array of command strings for this action.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get commands(): string[];
```

## Remarks

The action must be initialised via [Action.initialise()](./xpm-lib.action.initialise.md) before accessing this property. Attempting to access commands from an uninitialised action will result in an assertion error.
